name: hireburn
description: Open-source AI HR hunter: record your AI avatar once, reach candidates at a human pace, let the avatar run first interviews, and see where your funnel leaks. Record-once avatar interview kit with mandatory AI disclosure, human-pace LinkedIn outreach queue where a person sends, and hiring-funnel loss accounting with a disclosure checklist against NYC Local Law 144, the Illinois AI Video Interview Act, Illinois HB 3773 and the EU AI Act. No dependencies, no network calls.

referencePublication.name: AI Hiring in a Live Company: A 36-Day Case Study of an AI Hiring Agent and an AI Interview (payrollburn, part 2 of "AI managers in a live company")
